message.content: I'm ending my turn without making any more moves this turn. p4 has now turned down three offers for New York Avenue, and anything bigger would cost me too much. Buying back Boardwalk would cost $220 and leave me only $258. That's too little with p3's hotels costing up to $600 a hit, so I'm keeping my $478.
